name: print-social-flyer-electric-scooter-green-repeat-headline
title: Green electric transport flyer with repeated stacked headline
whatItIs: A square flyer on a lime-green background with a black photo panel, a repeated 'THE BEST TRANSPORT' headline stacked three times in shifting gradient colors, and a rotated 'ELECTRIC' text running vertically.
whatItMeans: Repeating the same headline phrase directly on top of itself in slightly different colors creates a strobing, glitch-like emphasis effect without needing motion or video.
techniques: stack the identical headline phrase multiple times in different colors for a strobe/echo effect
run supporting text vertically along the frame edge to use otherwise empty margin space
convert the hero photo to black-and-white so only text and small accent shapes carry color

vocabulary.definition: repeating the same text in a stack with slight offsets or color shifts to create visual vibration
